headline: Nvidia CEO declares AGI has arrived as OpenAI IPO approaches
body: Nvidia's Jensen Huang announced that artificial general intelligence has arrived, coinciding with OpenAI's pre-IPO financial disclosures showing $38.5B in losses. This timing matters for healthcare AI vendors and consultants evaluating long-term viability of foundation model providers entering clinical workflows. OpenAI's financial structure and public market debut will directly influence pricing models, API reliability commitments, and enterprise contract terms that health systems depend on for AI-powered clinical documentation, diagnostics support, and administrative automation. The AGI declaration also raises questions about regulatory readiness in healthcare, where claims of advanced AI capability trigger FDA oversight and liability frameworks that are still being established.
